answer: Correlated action audit records each identity's request timing, content overlap, and graph links, then flags clusters whose behavior is too synchronized. Like a prism, it separates aggregate traffic into per-identity traces and computes a shared-operator score. A repeated low-value pulse across accounts raises that score, triggering review and quarantining linked identities. Even a sparrow account pays a fixed per-identity audit fee and forfeits queued work.
